title: Canonical pullback comparisons intertwine coefficient-map iterates
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $h:W\to X$ a morphism of schemes, and $t:X\to X$, $t_W:W\to W$ endomorphisms with $ht_W=th$. Use ordinary derived categories of constant $A$-module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites, with exact inverse images $Lf^*=f^{-1}$ as in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Let $P_m=L(t^m)^*$ and $Q_m=L(t_W^m)^*$ for $m\geq0$, using the identity comparisons at $m=0$. Let $d^X_m:P_{m+1}\xrightarrow{\sim}P_1P_m$ and $d^W_m:Q_{m+1}\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_1Q_m$ be the canonical pullback-composition comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. Write $c_m:Q_mLh^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh^*P_m$ for the comparison obtained from $ht_W^m=t^mh$. For every derived complex $K$, these canonical comparisons satisfy
$$Lh^*(d^X_{m,K})\circ c_{m+1,K}=c_{1,P_mK}\circ Q_1(c_{m,K})\circ d^W_{m,Lh^*K}\quad(m\geq0).$$
For any morphism $u:P_1K\to K$, define $u_1=u$ and $u_{m+1}=u\circ P_1(u_m)\circ d^X_{m,K}$. Put $v=Lh^*(u)\circ c_{1,K}$ and define $v_m$ by the same recursion with $Q_m,d^W_m$. Then
$$v_m=Lh^*(u_m)\circ c_{m,K}\quad(m\geq1).$$
No invertibility, finite-type or Cartesian-square hypothesis is required.
